design_philosophy: A premium, mobile-first boutique experience for Indian women's fashion. Combines the approachability of organic/earthy tones with the editorial elegance of luxury design. Interfaces must feel tactile, warm, and sophisticated. The design relies heavily on beautiful serif typography, generous negative space, and a muted, earthy color palette. Since no real photos are used, typography and color blocking are the heroes of the visual experience.

hierarchy.h1: font-heading text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight text-text_main font-medium
hierarchy.h2: font-heading text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight text-text_main font-medium

layout_and_spacing.general: Mobile-first approach. Heavy use of padding to create an editorial, airy feel. Avoid tight, cluttered rows.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Use max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.

grid_patterns.bento_features: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-8
grid_patterns.lookbook_asymmetric: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-8 (Use col-span-8 for main, col-span-4 for secondary)

navigation.mobile_menu: Sheet component from Shadcn customized with background color #FAFAF7

admin_dashboard.layout: Grid-based with sidebar navigation. Dense data tables.
admin_dashboard.style: Clean, flat cards with 1px border. No heavy drop shadows. High contrast text.
admin_dashboard.components: Use customized Shadcn UI tables, inputs, forms, tabs.

media_and_images.CRITICAL_RULE: ABSOLUTELY NO EXTERNAL IMAGES OR PLACEHOLDER URLS (no via.placeholder.com, unsplash, etc.). Use pure CSS colored divs with elegant text inside them for all visual assets.

hero_placeholder.class: w-full min-h-[70vh] bg-secondary relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden
hero_placeholder.visuals: Add a subtle CSS radial gradient or repeating linear gradient to add texture. Example: background-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, #F3F1EB 0%, #E8DCCB 100%);
hero_placeholder.content: Overlay an elegant text arrangement: an 'overline' (NEW COLLECTION), a massive 'h1' (Timeless Elegance), and buttons.

product_placeholder.class: w-full h-full absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-4 text-center
product_placeholder.backgrounds: Rotate through subtle classes: bg-[#EFECE5], bg-[#F2EBDE], bg-[#EBE5E0], bg-[#E5E7E1]
product_placeholder.text: Display the category or a stylized monogram using the 'font-heading' font, colored with text-text_muted/50 text-2xl.

category_placeholder.class: w-full aspect-square md:aspect-[4/5] bg-surface relative flex items-end p-6 border border-border_subtle transition-colors hover:border-primary

icons.style: Elegant, thin, lightweight to match the luxury aesthetic.

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case and role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind configuration mapping to the exact HEX codes provided in the 'colors' section. Do not use default tailwind slate/gray.
2. Add Google Fonts import for Cormorant Garamond and Manrope in the global index.css file.
3. Apply 'bg-background text-text_main font-body' to the main html/body tag.
4. Construct the Product Listing and Product Detail pages using local hardcoded arrays (e.g., const products = [...]) that contain simulated data (title, price, category, etc.).

5. When rendering products, heroes, and categories, use ONLY pure HTML/CSS DIV placeholders exactly as specified in the 'media_and_images' section. DO NOT under any circumstances use tags with external generic placeholder URLs.
6. Build a persistent wishlist using localStorage. Include a toggleable heart icon on the Product Detail and Product Card components.
7. Implement the floating WhatsApp CTA button fixed at bottom-right, styled elegantly with the customized whatsapp_green color.
8. The admin dashboard should simulate JWT login state (hardcoded user/pass check) and provide a basic CRUD table view for products with Shadcn components customized to match the brand colors.
9. Build mobile-first. Ensure the navigation turns into a hamburger menu on small screens, and product grids scale from 2 columns on mobile to 4 on desktop.
10. Ensure EVERY button, input, tab, and clickable card receives an appropriate data-testid attribute for automated testing.
